name: unipaper-bridge
description: Research papers autonomously, try lawful open access first, use local institutional access only when needed, and preserve important sources in Zotero with user consent.

interface.shortDescription: Research, library access, and Zotero capture
interface.longDescription: Runs the normal scholarly research workflow, verifies whether full text is actually readable, automatically opens the isolated local KHU browser only as a last-mile fallback, and saves material sources to the user's local Zotero library after opt-in. It never returns university credentials, cookies, sessions, or licensed full text through MCP.
defaultPrompt: Research this paper, use my configured university access only if lawful public full text is unavailable, and save material sources to Zotero when authorised.
이 주제의 핵심 논문을 조사하고, 원문을 못 읽을 때만 설정된 경희대 로컬 접속을 사용하며, 허용된 경우 중요한 원문을 Zotero에 저장해줘.
